note: Superseded as a recommendation; kept because the sweep artifacts reference
it. The reasoning below described the code before the display-quantum fix,
when the interaction target was used as configured: at 16 ms an increase
needed an estimate under 12.8 ms, which vsync makes unreachable on a 60 Hz
display, so quality could only ratchet down.
That fix now raises a 16 ms target to about 23.9 ms, so 24 is what the
default already is, and it is the worst of the three rather than 'one
quantum of headroom': its band of 19.1 to 28.6 ms admits neither a one
refresh interval nor a two, and on a real GPU zero of 1527 moving frames
landed inside it. Raising the target to 33 does let the loop settle, but
only by giving up 60 Hz, and measured on hardware it holds no calmer than
the default while drawing less and settling short of full density.
See interaction-churn.json for the configuration that isolates the source,
